sketches.mechanism: Ownership of a non-Copy value is moved on assignment, and any later use of the moved binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given away cannot also remain in the giver.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes a weak optional reference when the referenced object has no strong owners left.
sketches.resonance: A memory held weakly disappears the moment nothing living holds it strongly.

sketches.mechanism: A return statement in a finally block executes during unwinding and overrides an earlier return from the try block.
sketches.resonance: The last obligation can rewrite even a completed departure.
